summary: Iteration 20 — frontend-only verification at 390x844 of the two fixes shipped after iter19 and the new sniffing-hero behaviour. FIX 1 (incident resolveAll): VERIFIED — with the chain message('CommBank: your account is locked. Verify now at https://commbank-secure-verify.top/login') → account (mfa_prompt / bank / initiated-no / run) the Home 'home-scent-<id>' card opens /patrol/scent/<id> where incident-count = '2 connected events' and BOTH linked events are 'Barking active' before resolve. Tapping incident-resolve fires the toast 'Incident marked handled. Apollo keeps the record.', the 'incident-handled' pill appears on the summary card, and BOTH incident-event-0 AND incident-event-1 now render the 'Handled' pill. On the Patrol tab BOTH patrol-item-* rows show 'Handled' with no active Barking. The iter19 stale-closure bug is fully fixed (upsertEvent now uses eventsRef.current for its base list; back-to-back awaited upserts each see the previous write). FIX 2 (URL-only share alternatives): VERIFIED — /share?url=https%3A%2F%2Fexample.com%2Fx renders share-kind 'Looks like a link' and now exposes share-alt-message, share-alt-email AND share-alt-account. Tapping share-alt-message navigates to /message?text=https%3A%2F%2Fexample.com%2Fx&source=share with the URL correctly prefilled in the message-text input. SNIFFING GIF: OBSERVED SEQUENCE — during Home 'Verify now' the hero label stayed 'Apollo is patrolling' and the animation container stayed 'apollo-hero-anim-resting' throughout ~3s of ≤50ms polling; apollo-hero-gif-sniffing was never mounted. Root cause is timing (not a bug): the mock adapter's refresh path (getCapabilities/getProtectionStatus/getProtectionPermissions/getNetworkStatus) has NO artificial delay in MockSecurityAdapter.ts (only startProtection/blockDestination/requestProtectionPermission use delay()), so setRefreshing goes false in the same microtask on web and the transient sniffing state is never painted. Per the review guidance this is not a failure — the final state is correct and no errors occur. The sniffing GIF and testID are correctly wired in ApolloHero.tsx (line 116-117) so they will paint on a device where refresh actually takes measurable time; the code is verifiable. Note: /message uses its own testID 'message-sniffing' Card during the sniffing phase and that DID render (visible during message-check → until result appears). REGRESSION SMOKE: /email, /app-check, /network all open and close cleanly (no console errors). Home hero after resolve shows 'Apollo is growling' — this is because the state resolver has a cooldown/recovering window before it settles back to patrolling; a manual Verify now (or the 30s tick) would return it to patrolling; not a bug.
action_items: Optional (nice-to-have): If the sniffing hero animation must be observable on the web preview, add a small (~300-600ms) artificial delay to MockSecurityAdapter.getCapabilities / getProtectionStatus (or wrap refresh() with a minimum-visible-duration in ApolloContext) so the transient sniffing state is paintable on web. On a real device Network.getNetworkStateAsync + the platform calls already take long enough to be visible; on web everything resolves synchronously.

Optional cosmetic: after resolving an incident the Home hero is 'growling' because the resolver stays in a recovering window until the next verify tick; consider immediately re-resolving (call verifyNow inside resolveAll) so users see the state relax after they mark the incident handled.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/store/ApolloContext.tsx:276-293 — upsertEvent now reads eventsRef.current for its base list (`const events = eventsRef.current`) and persistEvents synchronously updates eventsRef before setEvents. This is the correct fix for the stale-closure and is verified end-to-end.

/app/frontend/src/share/classifyShare.ts:42-55 — alternativeRoutes now emits message/email/account routes from `raw || url`, so URL-only shares surface share-alt-message/-email/-account as the spec requires.
